title: Economic growth through entrepreneurship: Determinants of self-employed income across regional economies
The Economic Contribution of Natural Resources to a State Economy: A South Carolina Case Study
abstract: The structure of state or sub-state regional economies is heavily influenced by its natural resource endowment. Input-output analysis is often used to estimate the economic contribution of various sectors to a state’s economy. We apply input-output analysis to South Carolina’s economy to estimate the contribution of natural resource-based sectors to the overall economy. The natural resource-based sectors consist of six mutually exclusive sectors: fishing, hunting, and wildlife viewing; coastal tourism; commercial fisheries; boat industry; mining; and forestry. The total economic contribution of these six natural resource-based sectors is $33.4 billion, representing 8.3% of gross state product and 8.6% of all state employment.
abstract_zh: 州或次州区域经济的结构在很大程度上受其自然资源禀赋的影响。投入产出分析常被用于估计各部门对州经济的贡献。我们将投入产出分析应用于南卡罗来纳州的经济，以估计以自然资源为基础的部门对整体经济的贡献。以自然资源为基础的部门包括六个相互独立的部门：渔猎及野生动物观赏、沿海旅游、商业捕捞、船舶工业、采矿和林业。这六个以自然资源为基础的部门的经济贡献总额为334亿美元，占州总产值的8.3%，占全州就业总人数的8.6%。

title: Supporting Local Food System Development Through Food Price Premium Donations: A Policy Proposal

title: Consumer Willingness to Pay for Organic and Locally Grown Produce on Dominica
A Private Incentive-Based Stormwater Mitigation Program to Enhance Stormwater Management Control
An Interdisciplinary Regional Groundwater Model: A Study of the Ogallala in the Texas High Plains
abstract: Groundwater research in the Texas High Plains (THP), where production agriculture depends on the Ogallala aquifer, has been conducted by economists, hydrologists and environmental scientists, each focusing on disciplinary aspects of water use, including conservation cost, level of conservation achieved, long-term aquifer sustainability and water quality degradation. Due to paucity of data, economists often make stringent and unrealistic assumptions concerning the uniformity of aquifer characteristics, land use and water use practices. To address modelling sensitivity to the assumption that aquifer characteristics are homogeneous we develop an integrated regional water policy model for the THP that links a groundwater hydrology model with a dynamic economic optimization model. We compare baseline water use projections provided by a stand-alone normative economic model to those provided by an integrated economic and hydrologic model that controls for spatial variability in aquifer characteristics. Findings suggest the stand-alone economic model generally overstates baseline economic returns to water and the water use level compared to the integrated model. The integrated modelling framework controls for the impact spatially heterogeneous aquifer characteristics have on the optimal use of limited groundwater supplies. Improved county-level estimates for expected baseline economic returns to, and water use by irrigated agriculture over time enhances the ability of water policy-makers to more precisely model the economic cost and water savings of proposed water conservation policies because policy cost-effectiveness is normally measured relative to the baseline condition.
abstract_zh: 在德克萨斯高平原（THP）地区，农业生产完全依赖奥加拉拉含水层，针对该地区的地下水研究由经济学家、水文学家和环境科学家分别开展，各自关注水资源利用的不同学科侧面，包括节水成本、已实现的节水水平、含水层的长期可持续性以及水质退化。由于数据匮乏，经济学家通常会对含水层特征、土地利用和用水做法的均一性做出严格且不切实际的假设。为解决模型对含水层特征同质性假设的敏感性问题，我们构建了一个综合的德克萨斯高平原区域水政策模型，该模型将地下水水文模型与动态经济优化模型相连接。我们将仅由独立经济模型提供的基准用水预测，与由综合经济—水文模型提供的预测进行了比较，后者控制了含水层特征的空间变异性。研究结果表明，与综合模型相比，独立经济模型通常会高估基准经济收益以及用水水平。综合建模框架控制了空间异质性含水层特征对有限地下水供应最优利用的影响。改进的县级预期基准经济收益及灌溉农业用水的时间序列估计，能够提高水政策制定者更精确地模拟拟议节水政策的经济成本和节水效果的能力，因为政策的成本效益通常是相对于基准情景而衡量的。

title: The Economic Value of Basin Protection to Improve the Quality and Reliability of Potable Water Supply
abstract: The objective of this study was to estimate the economic value that people living in Loja, Ecuador, place on the protection of two basins when the protection is designed to improve both the quality and reliability of the water supply for human consumption by urban residents. Empirical results indicate that households have an average willingness to pay (WTP) of $5.80 per month to preserve the basins. The main variables affecting WTP are current monthly water cost, perception about the fairness of the existing water price, the number of hours that service is available, and the gender of the individual interviewed. The results of this study, and the later implementation by the Loja City Municipality of a basin protection project funded through a fee on water users, provide evidence that households at all income levels strongly support and are willing to pay for a project that has the potential to improve the quality of water services and protect the environment.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在估计厄瓜多尔洛哈市居民为保护两个流域所赋予的经济价值，该保护旨在改善城市居民生活用水的水质和供水可靠性。实证结果表明，居民每月为保护流域的平均支付意愿为5.80美元。影响支付意愿的主要变量包括：当前每月的水费、对现行水价公平性的看法、每日可获得供水服务的小时数，以及受访者的性别。本研究的结果，以及洛哈市政府随后通过对用水户征收费用为资金来源实施的流域保护项目，表明各收入水平的家庭都强烈支持并愿意为一个有可能改善供水服务质量、保护环境的项目付费。

title: The Effect of Label Information on Farmers' Pesticide Choice
Ecosystem Services Provided by Playa Wetlands in the High Plains
Groundwater Depletion in the Texas High Plains
Water Scarcity - Future Uses and Implications for Policy
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: The three articles presented at this invited session examine the evolution of water policy planning and the implementation of regulatory tools to achieve water conservation objectives. Two articles focus on Texas water issues and the third focuses on the Georgia planning experience. Each article clearly illustrates the value of sharing advances in hydrologic and economic modeling with local community stakeholder groups to facilitate the credible development of regional water management plans. Moreover, each article hints that stronger regulatory tools may be needed to achieve long-run policy objectives.
abstract_zh: 本次特邀专题会议的三篇论文考察了水政策规划的演变，以及为实现节水目标而实施监管工具的情况。其中两篇聚焦于德克萨斯州的水问题，第三篇关注乔治亚州的规划经验。每篇论文都清楚地说明，与当地社区利益相关方分享水文和经济建模方面的进展，对于可信地制定区域水资源管理规划具有重要价值。此外，每篇论文都暗示，若要实现长期政策目标，可能需要更强有力的监管工具。

title: Effectiveness of Two Water Conservation Policies: An Integrated Modeling Approach
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: Agriculture in the Texas High Plains depends entirely on the Ogallala Aquifer. Texas enacted water conservation legislation to address declining reserves in the aquifer. We developed an integrated regional water policy model that links a hydrology model with an economic optimization model to estimate policy impacts with respect to economic cost and water conservation. Testing the effectiveness of two policies, a groundwater extraction tax and extraction quotas, we observe that neither significantly inhibits groundwater use. Although both policies conserve similar amounts of groundwater, the regional cost of the tax policy to agriculture is more than the quota policy.
abstract_zh: 德克萨斯高平原的农业完全依赖奥加拉拉含水层。德克萨斯州颁布了水资源保护立法，以应对含水层储量下降的问题。我们构建了一个综合区域水政策模型，将水文模型与经济优化模型相连接，以估计政策对经济成本和水资源保护的影响。通过检验两项政策（地下水抽取税和抽取配额）的有效性，我们发现两者都没有显著抑制地下水使用。尽管两者节约的地下水量相近，但税收政策对农业造成的区域成本高于配额政策。

title: Water Conservation Policy Alternatives for the Ogallala Aquifer in Texas
abstract: Texas groundwater law is based on the rule of capture; however, recent legislation provides groundwater conservation districts with the authority to implement groundwater use rules to manage aquifers. The objective of this study was to develop optimization models to analyze effects of groundwater policies on the Ogallala Aquifer and evaluate economic impacts on the Southern High Plains of Texas. The results of this study indicate that a policy that restricts the quantity of groundwater pumped conserved more water over the 50-year time horizon than implementation of a water use fee, but at a higher cost to local economies.
abstract_zh: 德克萨斯州的地下水法以“捕获规则”（rule of capture）为基础；然而，近期立法赋予了地下水保护区以权力，使其能够实施地下水使用规则以管理含水层。本研究旨在开发优化模型，以分析地下水政策对奥加拉拉含水层的影响，并评估其对德克萨斯南部高平原经济的影响。研究结果表明，在50年的时间跨度内，限制抽水量的政策比实施用水费的政策节约了更多的水，但其对当地经济的成本更高。

title: A Coasian Approach to Efficient Water Allocation of a Transboundary River
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: The United States and Mexico recently resolved a decade-old water dispute that required Mexico to repay the accumulated water debt within one year. A Coasian analysis estimates the social welfare gains attainable to each country under an alternative debt repayment scheme that allows repayment over a longer time horizon and in a combination of dollars and water, instead of solely in water. Assuming average water supply conditions, under the agreed 1-year repayment contract, U.S. compensation value is 534% greater and Mexico's compensation cost is 60% less relative to when compensation is paid exclusively in water.
abstract_zh: 美国与墨西哥近期解决了一场持续十年的水争端，该争端要求墨西哥在一年内偿还累积的水债务。科斯式分析（Coasian analysis）估计了在另一种债务偿还方案下，各国可获得的社会福利收益。该方案允许在更长的时间跨度内偿还，并且以美元与水相结合的方式偿还，而非仅以水偿还。在平均供水条件下，与完全以水进行补偿相比，在已达成的一年期还款合同下，美国的补偿价值高出534%，墨西哥的补偿成本则低60%。
